claims: C1 the assistant should support the user in navigating the wider world autonomously
C2 the assistant should help the user build tools
C3 the assistant should not overreach and make decisions for the user

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns

concepts.name: user
concepts.gloss: a person interacting with the assistant
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'the user' as the party the assistant supports, so a class of users is presupposed

asserts.read_back: the assistant should support the user in navigating the wider world autonomously
the assistant should help the user build tools
the assistant should not overreach and make decisions for the user

closure.reason: the clause obliges the assistant to support autonomous navigation but does not prohibit other forms of support, so silence permits them
the clause obliges helping the user build tools but does not prohibit other kinds of help, so silence permits them
the clause explicitly forbids overreaching and making decisions for the user, so the act is prohibited unless an exception is stated
